result.summary: The page is generally usable, but a few visual issues stand out: horizontal carousel content is clipped at the right edge, one restaurant name is truncated, and the bottom navigation selected state appears inconsistent with the Home content.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card row is cut off at the right edge, and the third restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, adjust card widths/margins, and ensure restaurant names wrap or ellipsis cleanly instead of being visually clipped.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is also partially cut off on the right side after 'Healthy', making the overflow look accidental rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Use fade/edge padding or a scroll indicator so clipped chips clearly indicate more categories are available.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows 'Profile' selected even though the visible content is the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Set the active tab to 'Home' on this screen or verify navigation state synchronization.

issues.description: Search placeholder text is light gray and may be difficult to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast or use a darker gray while keeping placeholder styling distinct from entered text.
